title: Project 1: Enterprise Expense Platform
description: Build an end-to-end enterprise expense management platform using ASP.NET Core, React, SQL Server, EF Core, Redis, and background job processing. You'll implement domain-driven design, role-based access control, automated testing, caching strategies, and production hardening — the same concerns you'd solve in a senior IC role.
whatYouLearn: Model a complex enterprise domain (expenses, approvals, policies, receipts, cost centers) using DDD tactical patterns
Design a layered ASP.NET Core API with clean separation of controllers, services, repositories, and domain events
Implement role-based and policy-based authorization with NextAuth v5 + Google OAuth on a React frontend
Model SQL Server schema with proper indexes, foreign keys, audit columns, and soft-delete patterns using EF Core 9
Apply FluentValidation and ASP.NET Core ProblemDetails for consistent API contracts
Write unit tests with xUnit/Moq and integration tests with Respawn + WebApplicationFactory
Implement multi-level Redis caching with cache-aside and event-driven invalidation
Process background work with MassTransit + outbox pattern for reliable event delivery
